situation: Deciding between Kubernetes and K3s for the cluster topology.
decision: Use K3s for edge/resource-constrained clusters (IoT, ARM, embedded); use full Kubernetes only for central/high-scale infrastructure.
reasoning_physics: K3s is a lightweight Kubernetes distribution, optimized for edge nodes, not a separate layer beneath K8s. Edge nodes are resource-constrained; a full K8s control plane there wastes the very headroom the edge lacks.
